purpose: Teach: 特区/能率/退席/実演/私見/既成/中長期/振替

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、経済特区での事業展開を検討しろ
lines.en: I want you to explore business opportunities in the economic special zones.
lines.style: Authoritative and measured. Direct eye contact. Clipped phrasing on key terms. The tone of someone used to being listened to — not rushed, but commanding attention through stillness.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。業務の能率改善を継続しております
lines.en: Yes, sir. We're continuing to improve operational efficiency across the board.
lines.style: Respectful but steady. No servility in the voice — professional deference. Clear articulation. Slight pause before the main clause, showing he's absorbed the directive and formulating his response.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 途中退席する社員に注意しろ
lines.en: And address the staff members who are leaving early.
lines.style: Firm addendum. Shift in intensity — this is a secondary but non-negotiable point. Held eye contact. Slight weight on 'address,' not accusatory but unmissably serious.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新製品の実演会を計画しております
lines.en: Understood. We're planning a product demonstration for the new line.
lines.style: Efficient acknowledgment. Matter-of-fact tone. No extra flourish — just the relevant information delivered cleanly. Demonstrates he's already thinking one step ahead.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 私見ではあるが、新事業は急ぐべきだ
lines.en: This is my personal assessment, but we should accelerate the new ventures.
lines.style: Thoughtful opening on 'personal assessment' — slight softening, showing he's offering perspective, not issuing decree. Then firmer on 'accelerate.' Leans forward almost imperceptibly. The confidence of experience.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。既成概念にとらわれず取り組みます
lines.en: Understood. We'll approach this without being bound by conventional thinking.
lines.style: Affirmation with conviction. Picks up the thread of his boss's intent. Warm undercurrent — he understands the spirit of what's being asked. Steady pace, each phrase weighted equally.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、中長期の経営計画を立てろ
lines.en: Now, I need you to develop a mid-to-long-term management strategy for the company.
lines.style: Shift to planning mode. Slower, more deliberate pacing. The weight of longer-term thinking evident in the tone. Slight breathiness on 'strategy' — this is the capstone directive.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。給与の振替日を見直しました
lines.en: Yes. I've also reviewed and adjusted the salary payment schedule.
lines.style: Closing note delivered with quiet confidence. Slight uptick in pace — shows he's already been working on parallel matters. Soft landing on the final clause, suggesting completeness and readiness.
